release_notes:
SOC Chat App v1.0.26 - Voice Messages Feature:
- Added voice message recording and sending for individual and group chats
- Cross-platform voice messaging support (Android, iOS, and Web)
- Compact and responsive voice message player UI with horizontal layout
- Real-time voice message playback with duration display
- Fixed UI overflow issues in voice message display
- Enhanced error handling and logging for voice message uploads
- Improved media upload flow with better progress tracking
- Various stability improvements and bug fixes
